# LinkLasso

> LinkLasso — select, open & export multiple links. Drag a box to open, copy or export links with filters, metadata enrichment and a smart open queue for SEO research.

## Product

- [LinkLasso](https://linklasso.fodylabs.com/): the browser extension.
- [Linkclump alternative](https://linklasso.fodylabs.com/linkclump-alternative/): how it compares to Linkclump.
- [Privacy](https://linklasso.fodylabs.com/privacy/): privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://linklasso.fodylabs.com/terms/): terms of service.
